# PlotTheChart - AI Context

> PlotTheChart is a TanStack Start Data Visualization Studio that allows users to instantly generate, configure, and save beautiful charts without writing code.

## Core Value Proposition
PlotTheChart provides a general-purpose, domain-neutral workflow: Enter Data → Visualize → Configure → Save. 
It supports dynamic inputs for tabular series (Bar, Line, Area, Radar), proportional slices (Pie, Donut), coordinate points (Scatter, Bubble), and hierarchical trees (Treemaps).

## Architecture & Tech Stack
- Framework: TanStack Start, TanStack Router, React 19
- UI/Styling: Tailwind CSS v4, shadcn/ui
- Data Visualization: TanStack Table v9, Recharts/D3 (abstracted via ChartCanvas)
- Database: Prisma ORM (PostgreSQL)
- Auth: Better Auth

## Key Features
- **Anonymous Chart Generation**: Users can try the studio and generate charts without an account.
- **Polymorphic Data Model**: Automatically adapts to different chart schemas without forcing everything into a rigid row/column table.
- **Extensibility**: Open-closed chart registry allows for adding new chart types with zero database migrations.
